description:
New workspace rule: upstream reference repos should be cloned by default into gitignored vendor/ folders inside the crates that port them, instead of relying on parent-level sibling folders (../openmc, ../NJOY2016).

Scope:
- crates/outram-mc-libs/vendor/openmc  -> gitignored clone of upstream OpenMC C++ source (canonical port reference).
- crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/vendor/NJOY2016 -> gitignored clone of upstream NJOY2016 Fortran source.

Deliverables:
1. Add per-crate .gitignore entries (or root .gitignore) for the vendor/ dirs.
2. Add a vendoring mechanism so the clone happens 'by default' -- decide: a setup script (scripts/vendor.sh), a per-crate build.rs/xtask, or documented make target. Pin/record upstream commit for provenance (RESEARCH_INTEGRITY_AND_PROVENANCE.md).
3. Codify as a workspace rule in root CLAUDE.md (and mirror to AGENTS.md).
4. Ensure GPLv3/provenance headers + licence notes are respected; vendored trees are reference-only, not compiled into the crates.

Deferred to active working hours (created 07:00 Wed 2026-07-15, before 07:30 start).

description:
Split from op-9c2e (GitHub issue #30 body, point 2: 'i want this integrated as a pdf reader, don't want to screenshot then digitise slowly, everything should be integrated into the reader'). Depends on op-6ez3 (PDF page rendering engine decision) -- cannot render a page without it.

SCOPE: a paginated PDF viewer panel inside kovan-gui -- open a PDF (via op-689u's file picker), render/scroll pages, zoom. This is the display surface that op-9c2e's region-select-and-digitise workflow (plot: bead TBD, table: bead TBD) and BibTeX-from-open-PDF (bead TBD) both attach to; those are separate beads so this one stays scoped to 'can I open and read a PDF in kovan', not the digitise/cite interactions on top of it.

Blocked on op-6ez3's engine choice being approved first.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: new digitiser/gui/desktop/pdf_reader.rs -- PdfReaderState opens a PDF via kopitiam_pdf::mupdf::PdfDocument::open, pages via rasterize_page at a fixed 150 DPI, one page rasterized+cached at a time (not the whole doc up front). Wired into DigitiseApp via a top-bar Digitiser/PDF Reader view switch. Zoom scales the displayed texture (no re-rasterize per zoom level -- documented as a known limit, not fixed). Display-only: does not yet feed a page/crop into the digitiser as an image source -- that is op-p17q, separate and still unimplemented. Split gui.rs into gui/mod.rs + gui/desktop/{mod,theme,pdf_reader}.rs to stay under this crate's file-size-cap convention. Verified: cargo check clean both targets, cargo tree confirms no eframe/egui/egui-file-dialog leak to android, cargo test --release -p kovan green. Manual GUI smoke test only got as far as opening the native window/event loop before hitting a wgpu-surface failure specific to this headless sandbox (no GPU/DRI) -- not a code defect, but genuinely NOT interactively verified; flagged for the maintainer to click-test on a real desktop.

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content: Follow-up (op-wa1u): kopitiam-pdf bumped 0.2.6 -> 0.2.7 in kovan's Cargo.toml, wiring in kopitiam-pdf's new mandatory hayro fallback rasterizer (Apache-2.0 OR MIT, pinned =0.7.1) -- rasterize_page now transparently re-renders a page with hayro instead of painting advance boxes when kopitiam's own glyph decoders hit their ceiling. No call-site change needed in digitiser::gui::desktop::pdf_reader.rs. Maintainer-confirmed: the reader renders noticeably better now. Pushed to develop as df966e4f.

title: kovan-gui: integrated PDF reader view (paginated, in-app, replaces screenshot-then-digitise)
